app_url.description: Public URL of the API; used in email links and OAuth callbacks.

social.description: Social sign-in providers. Each needs secrets OAUTH_<PROVIDER>_CLIENT_ID and OAUTH_<PROVIDER>_CLIENT_SECRET (e.g. OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID; Apple uses OAUTH_APPLE_CLIENT_ID, _TEAM_ID, _KEY_ID and _PRIVATE_KEY); keel setup status lists them. Empty leaves auth-oauth out.

success_redirect.description: Frontend URL to land on after social sign-in, with tokens in the fragment.

mfa.description: Include auth-mfa (TOTP two-factor and recovery codes).

roles.description: Role names (admin_role gets every permission, others none until granted), or a full rbac roles map with permissions and inherits.
